summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K on May 5, 2026, reporting quarterly results for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The filing discloses financial highlights including profit before tax of $9.4bn, revenue of $18.6bn, and annualised RoTE of 17.3%. It also notes a disposal loss on classification as held-for-sale of $0.3bn for the planned sale of its business in Malta and the completion of the sale of its UK life insurance business. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation event, as it does not announce a new acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change.
